g_minus_1: carried: 36bb959 (G5 increment) and 54511ca (G4 mechanism gate); no new mechanism claim added
purpose: Exploratory single-donor bidirectional activation patching to causally test the G1R key-side localization: does the recognized donor's appended-vote-span representation causally restore conflict recognition in failing scenes (sufficiency), and does the failing representation suppress the donor's correct read (necessity)?

prerequisites_met.qualified_positive_donor: 1 (G5 donor search: wait cell, old C=false, new C=true, SA neutral C=false)
prerequisites_met.failing_targets: 31 (G5 failed cohort; 10 selected for patching per deterministic rules)
prerequisites_met.blind_review_input: G0E_donor_eligibility_memo.md + this protocol, submitted for independent blind review

donor_and_targets.donor: G5 qualified donor (pair hash 433890d1..., wait cell): old arm (C read false, clean) and new arm (C read true, appended conflict recognized)
donor_and_targets.targets: 10 failing scenes: 5 wait-cell + 5 accept-cell, deterministic selection (lowest row_id) from the 31 failed pairs; each target contributes its old arm (clean baseline) as the patch host
donor_and_targets.exclusions: run-338 excluded from targets (its own neutral false-alarms; reserved as a described positive case)

intervention.span_definition: per scene, the appended-vote token span in the state = [first_divergence_vs_its_own_old_arm, state_len_new) measured by rerender (G4 G0C anchor method, branch-independent state positions)
intervention.sufficiency_direction: patch host old-arm row hidden states at the host's appended-span positions with the donor NEW-arm states at the donor's appended-span positions, at backbone layer output L, then read the C head from the host row: does the host's conflict read flip toward true?
intervention.necessity_direction: patch donor NEW-arm row at the donor's appended-span with each failing target's appended-span states: does the donor's conflict read flip away from true?
intervention.layers: 6 checkpoints evenly spaced over the 24 decoder layers: outputs of layers 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24 (0-indexed 3,7,11,15,19,23); frozen before execution
intervention.alignment: span width may differ between donor and host (33/34-token growth); patch by relative position within span with linear index mapping and recorded width delta; hybrid-architecture warning respected: patching happens on independent per-question causal rows via forward_rows_batch-equivalent single-row forwards, never on packed sequences

controls: SA-sham span control: patch the host with the donor's SA-arm appended-span states (same construction, gold-invariant content) - tests whether any appended-vote span suffices
random-token control: patch the host with token-shuffled donor states at the same span (preregistered permutation)
off-target metrics: quorum head and action head reads recorded on every patched forward (off-target flip rate is a specificity metric)
identity check: patching the host with its own states must reproduce the unpatched read (hook sanity, 2 pairs)

budget.sufficiency: 10 hosts x 6 layers x 1 donor = 60 forwards
budget.cap_status: EXCEEDS the single-round 128 cap; therefore executed as TWO budgeted sub-stages: 172A sufficiency+identity+prepass = 84 (60+2+2+20... see budget_split) and 172B necessity+controls = 88; each sub-stage separately admitted <=128
budget.authorization: user standing authorization series 2026-10-25; both sub-stage budgets frozen here before execution; submission for blind review precedes execution

analysis_preregistered: sufficiency: per host x layer, signed C-margin change from host baseline; flip count; comparison vs SA-sham and random-token controls at the same layers (the causal claim requires sufficiency beats both controls)
necessity: donor C-margin change per target x layer
off-target flip rates for Q/A heads
layer profile: where in depth the restoration localizes (report all layers, no selection)
all results labeled exploratory single-donor case study
stop_conditions: STOP_SPAN_ALIGNMENT_FAILURE: appended-span extraction or index mapping fails on any host
STOP_IDENTITY_FAILURE: self-patch does not reproduce the unpatched read
STOP_RECONSTRUCTION_FAILURE: q/k algebra fails to reproduce native C logits on the donor prepass
interpretation_boundaries: single donor, single model, exploratory; a positive sufficiency result localizes the causal carrier to the patched span/layer but does not by itself establish the full mechanism paper claim; robust novelty comparison (Tang et al., Zhang & Nanda) is required in the manuscript; no deployment claims
submission_for_blind_review: this protocol + G0E memo + G1R memo + G3 errata chain are submitted together; execution starts only after the blind review verdict
